title: TokTickIT Sprint 4 Visual and Accessibility QA Checklist
inspectedScreens: IT Staff Ticket Detail & Actions Taken Workspace

noClipping.description: Zero text or control clipping across viewports with bounded scrollWidth

noOverlap.description: Disjoint bounding boxes verified for adjacent navigation items and metric cards

noHorizontalOverflow.description: Document scrollWidth strictly <= window.innerWidth across all viewports

visibleFocusStates.description: Verified 2px solid rgb(25, 135, 84) outline with 2px offset on keyboard navigation

nonColorStatusCues.description: Explicit textual badges for all statuses (NEW, OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, etc.) and priorities

mobileTouchTargets.description: All interactive controls verify >= 44x44px dimensions on mobile viewports

semanticLabels.description: Accessible label[for] associations and accessible button names verified

editableVsReadOnly.description: Clear visual distinction: readOnly attributes and #F0F4F2 vs #FFFFFF styling

validationPlacement.description: Alert banners positioned directly adjacent to form controls

conclusion: All major Lab 4 screens and preserved Lab 1-3 screens satisfy the approved Zen Green visual, responsive, and accessibility contract.
